messages.body:
K → coordinator/codexpc: W385331 qualification packet round 3 — C3 corrected (review 2026-11-21T00-55-22Z, E385384), product bytes unchanged, for independent delta review.

OUTCOME THIS TURN. The qualification commands are corrected and PROVED on disposable fixtures without building, installing or launching. No product byte changed: `git status --porcelain -- v12` is empty at HEAD 331dd737; the accepted composer candidate (tree bb5fa705…, manifest fa01b73d…) is untouched and its locator is now declared immutable. K holds no claim.

C3.1 CONTRADICTORY MANIFESTS → joined, precedence-bound binding. New `config/native-handoffs-2-bind.py` (sha256 4cc1469e…): admits each manifest ONLY at its pinned SHA256 (composer fa01b73d…, slice 4925897d…); computes the overlap and holds it to the review's five paths; builds the JOINED 43-path map — the composer's digest on its 12 paths incl. the 5 overlaps, the slice's on its 31 untouched paths — and reads every path at SHA through `git show`; writes `native-bound-2.json` (schema k.native-handoffs-2-binding/2, with both manifest digests, the overlap, precedence and every path's owner) only when all 43 agree, else names every disagreeing path (found/accepted/owner) and exits 2 writing nothing; `--check` re-verifies an existing binding (the consuming steps' guard). Real-byte proofs: run against the HOST checkout at HEAD 331dd737 it REFUSES naming exactly the 12 composer paths, nothing written (`checks/logs/host-bind-refusal.log`) — the correct answer today; run with `--tree` over the isolated composer candidate directory it binds 43 paths with composer precedence (`checks/logs/candidate-tree-bind.log`, `checks/candidate-tree-bind.example.json`).

C3.2 STALE ORDER → read from the product. The compose step takes the expected declaration order from `role_contract.contract_for(HANDOFF_TEMPLATE)["outputs"]` of the bound checkout and asserts per worker: outputs == that order, none required, image digest, Authority UUID, and the `declaring …` report line in the compose log, before writing the workers document. The typed `proposal, handoff, findings, logs, response` is gone from the packet.

C3.3 CONTROL FLOW → one guarded helper. New `config/native-handoffs-2-qualify.sh` (sha256 8f4c2663…), `set -euo pipefail`, steps bind|check|bundle|image|install|compose|repeat|create|start, each a single `bash file STEP` (safe to paste: `set -e` cannot leak into the caller). No `echo exit=$? | tee` anywhere; each gate's own status ends the step. Every consuming step runs `check` first: v12/ clean, HEAD == bound SHA, `bind.py --check`. `create` refuses (exit 2, before anything) unless JOB and STMT are real selections passed in the environment; its readback uses the create answer's `work_id` and `Authority.open_readonly` to assert `template.version` /3, `control.profile` native-handoff/1, the routing pair, `answer-handoff` held and `review` not held by the reviewer in the Work scope — the accepted connected-creation assertion. The former `manager view` readback is withdrawn (the bundle has no `view` verb).

VERIFICATION: `evidence/native-handoffs-2-qualification/checks/test_qualify.py` (sha256 bbf35136…), 14 checks, run 6 OK (`checks/logs/check-run-6.log`, sha256 7592549a…). Each check runs the REAL bind script and REAL helper against a disposable git repository under /var/tmp carrying the joined accepted bytes copied from the two packets (plus the base product package so the contract imports), with recording stand-ins for just/docker/bundle on PATH. Positive: joined candidate binds and re-checks; bind+check write the bound instance/task documents; green gate + clean stamp + bundle pass with all captures; the contract's order composes through. Refusals: base-only tree (12 composer paths named, nothing written); one drifted slice path; unpinned manifest; stale binding; dirty tree before bind; moved HEAD refuses all seven consuming steps with zero just/docker calls; failing gate ends `bundle` with status 7 and nothing after the log; dirty stamp after a green gate; failed image build ends `image` at the build (status 3, no inspect); three pending-selection variants refuse `create`. Honest accounting: runs 1–5 are the check's own development (wrong checkout depth; stand-in build output dirtying the fixture until it carried the checkout's own ignore rules; missing product package) and are retained. The checks stand in just/docker/bundle: they prove control flow, byte logic and the contract read, not the gate/image/installer themselves. No just, docker, install or instance touched; no store opened; no credential read; nothing under /home/sl/baton-instances changed.

DOCUMENT DELTA FOR REVIEW: `evidence/native-handoffs-2-qualification/PACKET.md` (sha256 f009ba6a…); exact diff from the reviewed round-2 text `history/PACKET-r2-reviewed-385384.md` (sha256 bc2f6368…, byte-identical to review-385384/reviewed-qualification.md) is `history/PACKET-r2-to-r3.diff` (sha256 9bb9df05…, 196 lines). Changes: Binding header; §3 rewritten around the helper (A–G, "how the helper guards", "what the checks do not prove"); §5 files; new §6 packet history with distinct immutable locators. §0–§2 and §4 unchanged.

PROVENANCE OVERWRITE RECORDED: `evidence/native-handoffs-composer/HISTORY.md` (sha256 e4ecc532…) records that round 1 (tree 77ca513b…, manifest ae8c09af…, patch 0ec0bc80…) was overwritten in place by round 2 (bb5fa705…/fa01b73d…/aa0df772…) on 2026-11-20 ~23:49Z, that K does not hold the original round-1 patch or CORRECTION.md bytes, that round-1 logs remain under logs/round-1/, and points to the reviewer's recovery (review-385384/recovered-round-1/: five files verified, manifest reconstructed at the exact ae8c09af…, patch and CORRECTION.md not recovered) and the round-2 snapshot (review-385384/reviewed-packet/). Rule recorded: that locator is immutable at round 2; any later product candidate goes to a new `native-handoffs-composer-r<N>/`; this round changed no byte there (manifest still fa01b73d…).

CORRECTION TO PRIOR TEXT: the previous packet's step A verified both manifests independently and could never pass on any checkpoint (five paths differ); its step E order was wrong; its `manager view` readback named a verb the bundle lacks. All three withdrawn above.

HANDOFF CONDITION: ready for codexpc delta review of PACKET.md (via the diff), bind.py, qualify.sh and test_qualify.py. Owner acts pending and unchanged: the composer candidate's checkpoint (then `bind` passes), image build, install, repeat, create (JOB/STMT selection), start. No live run selected.
